issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit test was added for the new mention behavior despite conventions requiring test-first coverage for every feature.

conventions.evidence: config/services.php:83 matches sibling webhook_url style; .env.example, docs/ops/devops.md:104, docs/ops/logging.md:116 and CHANGELOG.md:22 keep docs in sync; no service layer, Livewire, migration or UI pattern violated

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:49 mentionId(), app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43-46 mention/reserved construction; small focused private methods with clear names, consistent mb_* usage

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43-46 appends "\n<@ID>" on its own line; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:39-40 returns unchanged truncated body when null; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:65-67 trim + /^[0-9]{17,20}$/ with is_int cast; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:44 reserves mention length so total stays MaxContentLength; config/services.php:83, .env.example, docs/ops/devops.md:104, docs/ops/logging.md:116 document DISCORD_MENTION_ID

scope.evidence: .env.example, config/services.php, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md, CHANGELOG.md — every hunk serves the ping task, no unrelated refactor

security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:67 preg_match('/^[0-9]{17,20}$/') rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123 and embedded newlines; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:53-65 null/non-string/integer/trim handling silently emits no mention

simplicity.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:49-72 single small mentionId() helper reusing existing formatContent/redaction path; no new abstractions or duplication

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no *Test.php or tests/ hunks — only .env.example, CHANGELOG.md, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/*; happy-path, invalid-ID, and truncation-with-mention cases are untested

review.summary: Adds optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID ping to DiscordOpsAlert with strict snowflake validation and truncation-safe appending plus docs. Correct, secure, lean and well-scoped, but ships with no tests despite test-first conventions, so it needs changes before merging.
